newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber SIR20 stable in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber SIR20 stable in thin trade.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were stable in thin late trading on Thursday, with sellers seen holding firm to their offer prices, dealers said.
Dealers said February/March SIR20 offer prices were at 55.50-56.00 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan, 55.25-55.50 fob Surabaya, Padang and Palembang as well as at 54.75-55.25 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
"There were bids from London at 54.25 cents for February SIR20 fob Medan, 54.50 fob Jakarta and 55.00 fob Singapore, but there were no deals yet," one Jakarta dealer said.
The dealer said February/March SIR20 was last sold at 55.25 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan and at 55.00 fob Jakarta.
Dealers said sellers were seen holding firm to their offer prices due to expected continued short-covering ahead of year-end.
Data from Belawan Port showed that the MV Sun Flora will leave the North Sumatran port on Thursday for Singapore, with 800 tonnes of rubber.
